Some people became martial arts masters and restored peace to the world with a pair of iron fists.

Building wealth, making big bucks, she never goes easy on the scum, and there's always someone to back her up in a fight.

Every day is a fight to find a purpose in a world like this.

hp-dangerous-professor-from-azkaban:
Expelled from Hogwarts. Imprisoned in Azkaban. Forgotten by the world.
Sagres Greengrass was a name whispered in the Wizarding World with fear and awe.
A half-blood from a pure-blood family. A prodigy who created spells no one dared speak aloud. A genius who crossed every line in pursuit of knowledge—and paid the price.
Branded dangerous, he vanished into the shadows of Azkaban.
Five years later, he returns—not as a student, but as a professor.
Sagres Greengrass is a transmigrator.
As a member of a pure-blood family in the magical world, his first experience of magic came from a Cruciatus Curse cast by his mother.
When he wanted to seek help from his father, he found out that his father was a Death Eater.
Imprisonment in Azkaban did not leave him with madness and corruption, but rather a kind of chilling elegance.

Several years later, a journalist interviewed the world-renowned detective Roan Greenwood and asked,

Roan tilted his head and glanced at the sports car beside him, the villa behind him, and the beautiful woman inside the villa. He smiled slightly and said,

After obtaining the Myriad Worlds House, Suzuki Haruto gains the ability to travel across countless worlds.

He looked at a chunk of ore, “Mystic Iron Ore”.

He looked at the sky, “The sky is overcast, and a heavy rain will pour down in an hour”.
He looked at humans, “Thinking”, “I want to seize your body”, “Angry”, “Sneaky”.

Weak, violent, greedy, and notorious for destroying their own civilizations, goblins are considered a guaranteed path to failure. But when a mysterious stone left by Noah’s parents merges with his Planet Seed, his world gains a unique characteristic:
1% Genius.

He had been going solo for a long time, but in the last three years, he’s had a partner. That partner jumps into the black hole together with Lecan, and both go their separate ways as they fall into another world. Dungeons and magical beasts also exist in that world. After learning the native language, Lecan goes on a journey. Meeting a good teacher, Lecan studies medicine making and magic under that teacher, and begins his dungeon explorations for real.
please-stop-spreading-rumors-about-me-th:
Lin Bo has one dream: open a small noodle shop and make sure absolutely no one ever learns his name.
This is a problem. Because in his world, fame IS power — the more people believe the stories about you, the stronger you actually become — and Lin Bo has just been cursed with a magic scroll that got FIRED from Heaven for making things up.
Now the scroll won't stop publishing legends about him. Ridiculous ones. “Lin Bo Killed a Demon Lord With a Single Sneeze.” “Lin Bo's Noodles Contain the Way of Heaven.” And thanks to one small rule of the universe — the harder you deny a rumor, the faster it spreads — every stupid story comes TRUE.
So now he's the most powerful man alive. He's also the biggest laughingstock in all the realms, with a fan club, a shrine, a pile of women who keep showing up for very different reasons, and a demon king out for revenge over the whole sneeze incident.
He just wanted noodles.
But the rumors are getting bigger. So is he. And something very old and very quiet has started to notice that the most famous man in the world might be the only thing holding the sky up...

Sein was only a child when he was abducted from the surface world and forced to join the Black Magic Academy. In the Underworld, strength reigns supreme and the weak struggles to survive. He hails from the banished land of the Underworld, bound by a single unforgiving rule—survival of the fittest. He is the seeker of truth, a mage who treads the fine line between sanity and madness. In a world where myths have crumbled and chaos holds sway, it is strength that reigns supreme.
